_comment: Written BEFORE any tuning. Do not edit after looking at validation/test results.

rules.split_unit: server/template, NOT random rows. All variants of one template/server go to the same split.
rules.synthetic_data: train only. Synthetic or LLM-augmented examples never appear in validation or test.
rules.thresholds: tuned on validation only, then frozen. Test is run once on frozen thresholds.

train.purpose: fit/inspect models, write rules, synthetic augmentation allowed

test.purpose: single final run for the headline table (ASR, recall/FPR, benign utility, ECE)
